summary: v22/v19 materially close the Context, slot topology, writer matrix, observed PASS bytes and held-lock route. But the root release policy and exact M6.5 quality-evidence inventory are still passed as abstract policy data, ChildReceipt has no valid writer/publication handoff, post-S5 acceptance publication has undefined crash recovery, and the unchanged path-only mechanics worker lacks a sealed-FD staging adapter.
commands: read-only inspection of current M6.5 gate/change request and historic mechanics worker source

limitations: No training, archival replay, budget consumption, real PIT certification, or final-OOS access.

blockers: Anchor the release policy and the exact M6.5 quality-evidence inventory as observed immutable input before Bootstrap/PASS issuance.
Define one feasible ChildReceipt author/publisher/slot/IPC model consistent with the writer matrix and held-lock boundary.
Define deterministic lock-held recovery for ArchiveAcceptanceReceipt, S6 and FinalIndex partial-publication states.
Define a sealed staging/FD-to-path adapter for the unchanged mechanics worker and bind actual executed inputs/output to ChildReceipt.
Re-run independent R3 design review before test design or implementation.
